_comment: Per-landed-sprite placement tuning for the Mars ground UFOs. Authored with wwwroot/landed-editor.html; loaded by Compat/LandedOffsets.cs. All values are DESIGN-space pixels (800x600), +x right, +y down. 'landed' shifts the parked still's draw position; 'takeoff' shifts the ship's position once when it lifts off (so the flying sprite continues seamlessly, offsetting the landing feet); 'shadow' nudges the ground shadow (x, and y along the floor line); 'shadowSize' multiplies the shadow width. Identity (all 0, shadowSize 1) reproduces the original untuned behaviour.
